title: Recipe 10: Connect an external agent through MCP
titleZh: 方案10：通过 MCP 接入外部 Agent
summary: A real stdio MCP process connects to an open ticket page over loopback. The client receives describe and invoke, not the DOM or model credentials.
summaryZh: 真实 stdio MCP 进程通过回环地址连接打开中的工单页面。客户端拿到 describe 与 invoke，而不是 DOM 或模型凭据。

files.label: App.vue
files.roleZh: 工单记录与能力面暴露

files.label: README.md
files.roleZh: MCP 进程与客户端注册

guide.title: Keep the page open and the MCP client outside
guide.titleZh: 页面保持打开，MCP 客户端留在页面之外
intro: The stdio process is a transport facade. It does not inspect the DOM, hold a model key, or implement ticket business rules.
Start the page first, then start the MCP server. Ask the client to list tickets and reply to one record.
introZh: stdio 进程只是传输 facade。它不读取 DOM、不持有模型密钥，也不复制工单业务规则。
先启动页面，再启动 MCP server。让客户端列出工单并回复其中一条记录。

steps.title: Expose three named ticket capabilities
steps.titleZh: 暴露三项具名工单能力
steps.body: The Surface allowlist contains list, reply, and statistics. No generic click or script tool is added.
steps.bodyZh: 能力面白名单只包含列表、回复与统计，没有通用点击或脚本工具。

steps.title: Bridge only the protocol
steps.body: The page opens a loopback WebSocket and forwards describe or invoke requests to the existing Surface.
steps.bodyZh: 页面打开回环 WebSocket，把 describe 或 invoke 请求交给现有能力面。

steps.title: Register the stdio server
steps.body: The MCP client starts one command; the bridge port is loopback-only and the page must remain open.
steps.bodyZh: MCP 客户端启动一条命令；桥只监听回环地址，页面必须保持打开。

guide.note: Run the page and the MCP server in separate terminals. A hosted HTTPS endpoint needs an authenticated gateway; this loopback bridge is for local development.
guide.noteZh: 页面与 MCP server 分别运行在两个终端。公网 HTTPS 端点需要经过鉴权的网关；这里的回环桥只用于本地开发。
